releases.name: desktop: v0.54.0
releases.body:
## [0.54.0](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/compare/desktop-v0.53.0...desktop-v0.54.0) (2026-11-01)


### Features

* **rune:** the release lanes, integrated ([#1899](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/1899)) ([0c10403](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/0c10403475e2f4629f11358fd54b5a5ba3f50672))


### Bug Fixes

* **desktop:** load Omarchy's Ghostty theme include and drop Mac wording on Linux ([#1864](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/1864)) ([62af4ae](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/62af4ae03ec590b15477c0069d84d8f7a6aec985))

Desktop: Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized.

macOS: download phux-desktop-0.54.0-macos-arm64.dmg, open it, and drag Phux.app onto Applications. The ZIP is for automatic updates. Apple silicon macOS 26 or later; Ubuntu 24.04 GNU/Linux x64 and arm64 (X11 and Wayland; release qualification uses X11 with lavapipe). Recent DMGs include the phux CLI and server; older releases may require the separate CLI installer (https://phux.sh/install). Existing CLIs and running sessions are not replaced.

Windows x64: native desktop, WSL coordinator.

Install with the per-user PowerShell installer: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-phux/phux/main/scripts/install-desktop-windows.ps1 . The portable ZIP includes the same installer and the MSVC runtime. Requires an initialized WSL distribution with phux; signature verification requires minisign on Windows PATH or in WSL.

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.8 (alpha)
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.8**: a window that recovers, renders faster, and speaks plainly.

- **Connection recovery.** A dropped connection comes back by itself, and the
  window says where it stands: starting, connecting, no sessions, or a server
  that needs updating, each with what to do next.
- **Faster rendering.** A scrolled row keeps what it already built. Scrolling
  rebuilds 128 rows where it rebuilt 2,944, and a stream beside an idle split
  128 where it rebuilt 10,112. Box drawing, shades and Powerline glyphs now
  line up across cells.
- **One command table.** The shortcuts, the palette and the native menus run
  the same commands by the same rules.
- **⇧⌘W** closes the tab.
- **Agent attention** shows what needs you without drawing continuously, so an
  idle window stays idle.
- **Readable themes and keyboard Settings.** Every theme keeps its text legible,
  and Settings works without a mouse.
- **Copy Diagnostics** puts the facts a bug report needs on the clipboard.
- **Install it** with `curl -fsSL https://phux.sh/install | sh -s -- --rune`.

From alpha.6 this arrives by itself; earlier alphas need one manual download.
Signed, notarized and stapled. Alpha: one window on one machine. See
[clients/rune/README.md](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/blob/main/clients/rune/README.md).

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.7 (alpha)
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.7**: manual updates that answer.

- **Check for updates** in the palette, and **Check now** in Settings, always
  answer on the card: up to date, available, or what went wrong.
- **Update now** in the palette does whatever is due.

From alpha.6 this arrives by itself; earlier alphas need one manual download.
Signed, notarized and stapled. Alpha: one window on one machine. See
[clients/rune/README.md](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/blob/main/clients/rune/README.md).

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.6 (alpha)
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.6**: updates and machines.

- **Updates**, the GPUI desktop's flow: checks at launch and every six hours,
  a corner card, a real download percentage, minisign and checksum
  verification, install on quit or **Restart now** (back on your session). It
  also updates the phux CLI and hands the live server off without closing
  sessions. Settings has the switches. This release is the last manual
  download: alpha.5 and earlier can't update themselves.
- **Machines**: switch the window to any registered remote from under the
  sidebar's title, or add one with `me@host` or from your tailnet. If your
  sessions live on another computer, this is how you reach them.
- **⌘W closes right away.** **Confirm before closing** in Settings brings the
  question back, for tabs too.
- Rune moved to the latest `dev`.

Signed, notarized and stapled. Alpha: one window on one machine, no Kitty
images yet. See
[clients/rune/README.md](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/blob/main/clients/rune/README.md).

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.5 (alpha)
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.5**: an agent command center.

- **Inbox** (⌘I): everything waiting on you, across every session, answerable
  in place. Agent questions with one-click answers (⌘1–⌘9) or a typed reply,
  server-held approvals (⌘↩ / ⌘⌫), finished agents, failed commands.
- **Ask card**: the focused pane shows its agent's question; click to answer.
- **Notifications**: macOS notifications when something needs you and you
  can't see it, withdrawn when handled; clicking jumps there. The Dock counts
  what's waiting.
- **Tabs**: the session's groups, shared with the terminal UI. ⌘T, ⌘1–⌘9,
  double-click to rename.
- **Themes and settings** (⌘,): eight themes with live preview on your real
  terminals, text size, Option as Meta, copy on select.
- **Images and files**: paste an image for an agent to read; drop files on a
  pane to type their paths.
- **Sessions**: rename from the sidebar, end from the palette.

Signed, notarized and stapled. Alpha: one window, no Kitty images yet. It
needs the phux CLI and never installs or upgrades it. Verify an archive with
its `.sha256` file. See
[clients/rune/README.md](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/blob/main/clients/rune/README.md).
